subject.title: Control UI chat history hardcoded to 100 messages, no load more pagination

question: Should Control UI resolve this issue with a larger fixed initial history window, or should closure require a load-older pagination path using the existing `chat.history` offset contract?
rationale: Both approaches expose more history, but a fixed window changes every startup payload while pagination keeps the current bounded-history stability model documented for Control UI.

options.title: Require load-older pagination
options.body: Keep this issue open until Control UI can fetch older pages on demand while keeping the initial history request bounded.

options.title: Accept fixed window after proof
options.body: Allow the linked 500-message mitigation to close this issue only if maintainers accept the startup-payload tradeoff and the PR shows real Control UI proof.

recommendation.title: Require load-older pagination
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until Control UI can fetch older pages on demand while keeping the initial history request bounded.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Control UI chat-history code and recent split/refactor history route this UX/performance choice most clearly to steipete.
